# LLM Reliability + EvalOps Platform

This repository is a full-stack reference implementation for evaluating LLM-powered applications.

## Primary resources

- Project: https://github.com/Jakey794/llm-evalops-platform
- Live demo: https://llm-evalops-platform.vercel.app
- Architecture and setup: https://github.com/Jakey794/llm-evalops-platform#readme

## What it demonstrates

- Versioned evaluation datasets and prompts
- Deterministic and optional LLM-as-judge graders
- Quality gates with cost and latency thresholds
- A FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and Next.js architecture

## Important limitations

This is a portfolio/reference project. The included data is seed data, not customer data. The reference deployment has shared-role authentication, authorization, rate limits, and audit events, but it is not a hosted multi-tenant identity system and must not be represented as one.
